name: Copenhagen Sprint ME
story: At Copenhagen Sprint ME 2026, five riders escaped in the first kilometer. After the last intermediate sprint, Rodenberg dropped back to the peloton. A major crash 18km from the finish split the peloton into two groups. Groenewegen, Merlier, and Meeus were caught in the second group. The lead group was caught 500m from the finish, with Philipsen winning the final sprint ahead of Andresen and Welsford.
